accolades.label: World Cup Champion
accolades.description: Captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup title.

accolades.label: World Cup Golden Ball
accolades.description: The first player to receive the tournament’s Golden Ball twice.

accolades.label: Copa América Champion
accolades.description: Won the 2021 and 2024 CONMEBOL Copa América titles.

accolades.label: Champions League Winner
accolades.description: Won four European Cups with FC Barcelona.

accolades.label: Ballon d’Or
accolades.description: Received an eighth Ballon d’Or in 2023.

accolades.label: European Golden Shoe
accolades.description: Holds the record with six European Golden Shoes.

accolades.label: Domestic League Champion
accolades.description: Won ten Spanish league titles with FC Barcelona.

accolades.label: Domestic Cup Winner
accolades.description: Won seven Copa del Rey titles with FC Barcelona.
